content: CloudFlow is an AI-powered B2B project management and team collaboration SaaS platform built for growing startups and agencies. It automates task tracking, client reporting, and deadline alerts.
Starter Plan costs ₹999 per month (up to 5 users). Includes task boards, Slack integration, and email support.
Pro Plan costs ₹2,499 per month (up to 25 users). Includes AI sprint summaries, automated client reports, CRM sync, and priority 24/7 support.
Enterprise Plan has custom pricing starting at ₹7,999 per month for unlimited users, dedicated account manager, and custom SSO. Annual billing gives a 20% discount on all plans.
We offer a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, plus a 15-minute live product demo with our specialists available Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST.
All customer data on CloudFlow is encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, with automated daily cloud backups.
